def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(h - 2):

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        for y in range(h):
            lines.setdefault((y, cc), set()).add(color)
    for (r, c), colors in lines.items():
        out[r][c] = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else 0
    return out
